queue.claim: The landmark embeddings are a static set of 51 iBUG inner points and a dynamic 17-point jaw contour over 79 yaw bins (-39 to +39 degrees). MICA's MediaPipe embedding has about 105 points. The eyeballs are the last ~1,092 vertices, ~546 each.
A positive x rotation of the FLAME jaw opens the mouth. A plausible jaw-open range is about 0 to 0.5 rad, and neutral-view priors are σ 2–3°.
